reviews.text: 5***** For the first time we left Gimba and we couldn't have chosen a better service 😉 We want to thank the whole family for their affection and patience with Gimba. They were fantastic. Gimba is sad because he left his friends behind. One of these days he'll be back. Thank you ❤️

Lúcia and Ângelo, Grandma Pet+Grandpa Pet are unsurpassed in the care of our pampered pets, for us leaving Gimba with Entreajuda was an excellent decision, I once again leave a big thank you.
Every day we received updates on the state of our four-legged friend through photos and videos, excellent work.

Team, the best people! who love animals with tireless service and treatment, absolutely exceptional. Caring, empathetic and always present. The best way I can describe the service provided is that I could leave my pets for a longer period and be completely at ease, the same as if they were with me!
Simply, thank you!

We couldn't be happier with our experience at EntreAjuda Pet Sitting! 🐾❤️

We needed to find a solution for Waffle and Maple at the last minute and we were very lucky to find EntreAjuda. From the first contact we felt very confident and at ease, something that is essential for us, because our dogs are part of the family and we can't leave them with just anyone.

Throughout their stay we kept track of how they were doing and it was incredible to see them so happy, relaxed and enjoying themselves. They made new friends, discovered new things and had a real "vacation" experience. 🥹🐶🐶

The attention, affection and care they gave them made all the difference. We felt they were treated as if they were their own, and that means everything to us.

Thank you so much for welcoming @waffle.corgi and Maple, especially with such short notice, and for giving us this peace of mind while we were away. ❤️

Without a doubt, a ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ experience and a place we would leave them again without hesitation!

It couldn't have been better. It was the first time we used Lúcia and Ângelo's services and we couldn't recommend them more. We've never seen our Marie so comfortable with anyone from outside, from day one. The care they take in getting to know the family and the animal before visits makes all the difference, and the affection and attention they gave our Marie was exceptional.

We left our puppy there for the first time in December (he was 3 months old). They were incredibly attentive, especially since it was a weekend and very last minute, but they were always willing to help. From then on, we always leave him there on Mondays, and I'm sure it's his favorite day! He goes for walks in new places, has his zen moments to rest, and they send lots of photos and videos so we can follow along! Besides that, I have absolutely no doubt that it's the best service I've ever seen, because they don't just take care of the animals and feed them; they genuinely care about the animal's well-being and prepare it for the world by properly educating it. We've learned so much from them, and they always help us whenever they can! If there were more stars, I'd give them more!

My dog stayed with Lucia and her team for a week, and they went above and beyond in making him feel loved and cared for on a level we’ve never experienced before. From the intake to make sure they knew everything important to know about my dog, to many updates throughout the day to see what he was up to, training, to even providing a special treat for him based on a certain food he likes – he received undivided attention. We are so grateful to have found Lucia! ❤️

Our large dog and cat stayed with EntreAjuda for almost a week when we were moving out of Portugal. We had already moved and needed a safe place for them to stay while waiting for their flight. Lucia and Angelo were a perfect fit and such kind and helpful petsitters. They were vigilant about making sure our pets were cared for and felt as comfortable as possible in a new place. They were a huge help for us in preparing the pets ahead of their flight and made sure they were available when the transport company came to pick them up. We genuinely could not have done it without them and are very grateful for their help during a stressful time.

Throughout the stay, EntreAjuda sent us tons of updates, photos, and videos. It was clear that they came to really care for our dog and cat and were sad to see them go. I would absolutely recommend EntreAjuda to anyone looking for a safe and caring place for their pets. If we are ever in Lisbon again, we would absolutely use their services. Thank you so much, Lucia and Angelo!

Great experience! We left our young dog, just over 4 months old, for 3 nights (it was his first time).
We particularly appreciated Lucia and Angelo's immediately noticeable genuine passion for dogs and pets, and the opportunity to meet a few days beforehand to get to know each other. It made us feel much more secure and relaxed.
During our dog's stay, we received numerous updates, including photos and videos of how he was doing, what he was doing, and so on. This really helps! Since our dog is still very young, we greatly appreciated Lucia's experience with dogs, including training and understanding their behavior, how to positively reinforce what he already does well, and how to correct puppy behaviors that need improvement. It was excellent that our dog was able to be with other dogs in a safe and controlled environment.
We will definitely be back 😊
Everything went amazing. The dogs had a good time and they made sure to always update us throughout the day. I really appreciate the service and definitely recommend 🙏🏽

Leaving our anxious rescued girl with tia Lúcia and tio Ângelo was about trust,  something that surpassed our expectations. Amazing, caring and loving caretakers for pets. We are grateful for having them as our petsitters. Family environment, plenty of activity, tough love, training and a lot of fun. Thank you so much for everything! She'll be back :)

I loved it! Toshi stayed there and I felt so relieved knowing he was in such good hands. They were extremely careful and attentive to his needs, always with great care, dedication and attention to every detail.
I really liked the communication and you can clearly see the love and respect for the animals, and I felt that Toshi was treated as if he were at home.
I was very satisfied with the service and I recommend it without hesitation. It is, without a doubt, a place where I would leave Toshi again with peace of mind 🐾😍

I found the EntreEajuda Petsitting service through a Google Maps recommendation, and I have nothing but praise! ✨

We started with a pre-visit so Lola could get to know the space where she would be staying, and then Lúcia and Ângelo came to visit my house to understand a little about Lola's routine, as she was in their care for the entire weekend. 🏡

The routine of walks, feeding, and toileting was perfectly respected. They also took great care to always send photos and videos to show that Lola was well and comfortable. 🦊

Lola was accompanied at all times, both by her other "furry friends" and by Lúcia/Ângelo, who also took advantage of the weekend to visit the family and take all the dogs for walks together. 🐕

I'm very satisfied with EntreEajuda's services because while I was able to go for walks, Lola also got to enjoy trails, walks, and playing with the other dogs. 😃

My dog stayed with the EntreEajuda family for a month.

They sent me photos and videos every day, so I could see how well he had settled in and how much he was enjoying his stay. That gave me real peace of mind.

They took the time to understand his personality. From everything they shared, it was clear he wasn’t just being looked after. He spent time outdoors, met other dogs, and it felt like he was on holiday.

After trying different pet sitters over the years, this has been the best experience I’ve had. I wouldn’t hesitate to leave my dog with them again.

We couldn't have been more satisfied with the care, dedication, and professionalism of Lúcia and her team ;). From the first contact, we felt completely confident leaving our little Rafa with you.

Throughout his stay, we kept in touch through many photos, videos, and messages, which gave us immense peace of mind seeing our sweetie happy, well-cared for, and surrounded by so much affection (and adapted to the other four-legged friends).

The attention to detail, availability, friendliness, transparency, and genuine love for animals make all the difference. It's evident that each furry friend is treated as if they were part of the family.

We sincerely thank you for all the care, patience, and affection you showed our Raphael. We recommend your services without hesitation to anyone looking for a trustworthy place to leave their four-legged companion.

Thank you so much for everything! Keep up the excellent work. 🐶❤️

I am so grateful for the love and care Bobby received during these five days he stayed with Entreajuda Petsitting.

From the moment I met Angelo and Luciana, I could feel that this is much more than a job for them. They have such a beautiful, calm and welcoming energy, and it is very clear how deeply they care about animals. I deeply felt the love, passion, and dedication they bring to what they do.

Throughout my dog’s stay, they kept me updated with so many photos and videos, which meant so much to me. Knowing how happy, relaxed, and well cared he was allowed me to fully enjoy my time away without worrying. Every update reassured me that he was in the best hands.

What I appreciated most was seeing how much love and attention they gave him. They didn’t just feed him and take him for walks—they genuinely engaged with him, played with him, cuddled him, and made him feel part of their family. That level of care is incredibly important to me, and it made all the difference❤️

We will absolutely come back again and I recommend Entreajuda Petsitting deeply from my heart to anyone looking for a caring, responsible, and loving pet sitter. Thank you for everything🙏🏽

I recommend them 100%! We couldn't be more grateful for all the care and attention they gave our Kira. Lucia and Angelo were tireless and treated her with so much affection. Kira will definitely be back :)

Angelo e Lucia are simply amazing!

We and our dog were comfortable from the first meet and greet. You can tell em right away the organization and the care about your pet.

We had our flight delayed in the way back and Angelo and Lucia were super accommodating. During the dog staying they constantly send video e pictures that gave us a piece of mind. Highly recommend!

5/5 ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

To say that EntreEajuda Petsitting's service is excellent is an understatement! What led us to choose them was the search for someone completely trustworthy to care for the animals on our farm, and they exceeded expectations with their new PetFarmily service.

From the first contact, during the pre-visit, there was an immediate connection (at the time, with our only animal, our dog Fidel) between them and all of us.

What stands out most and gives us complete peace of mind is their commitment, the zeal and genuine care they demonstrate.

The transparency and detailed description of all the information and conditions of the service gave us security and the ability to organize things in a timely manner.

During our absence, the constant sharing of videos and photos allowed us to follow them very closely, and it was wonderful to see our animals included in their daily activities.

Besides their immense friendliness and attentiveness, the flexible hours, quick response, and meticulous attention to cleanliness are incredible advantages.

We wholeheartedly recommend EntreEajuda to any family seeking a conscious, professional, and deeply friendly choice for their furry friends. They are pure excellence in what they do!

I couldn't have chosen better people to take care of Bob 💙
They were absolutely impeccable from beginning to end: super attentive, caring, responsible, and always concerned about his well-being. Throughout the entire period I felt at ease because I perceived the genuine care and affection they had for Bob.

I received updates, photos, and lots of affection, and that made all the difference. It's so good to find people we can truly trust to leave a member of our family with.

I recommend them and will certainly leave Bob with you again. Thank you so much for everything!
Best pet sitting service ever, they make my Maggie so happy and it's such a relief for me to know I'm leaving her in the best hands 🤍 …

We've had an excellent experience with EntreEajuda Petsitting! From the first contact, they stood out for their friendliness, transparency, and great willingness to answer all our questions.

The pre-visit and the trial daycare were fundamental in putting us at ease. We immediately noticed the care, attention to detail, and genuine affection with which they treat the animals. Raphael felt comfortable and well-integrated, which is the most important thing for us.

We greatly value the constant communication, with the sharing of photos and videos, which allowed us to follow everything closely and further reinforced our trust. Their professionalism, organization, and love for what they do are clearly evident.

We wholeheartedly recommend EntreEajuda Petsitting to any family looking for a trustworthy, dedicated service with a truly caring and conscientious approach.

Thank you so much for all the care and dedication! 🐾✨

If it were possible, I would give it 7 stars!!! 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟

The experience with Lúcia and Ângelo (owners of EntreEajuda Petsitting) was simply extraordinary in EVERYTHING! Without exception and without any negative points to mention. 🙏🫶😘

So that others can get an idea of ​​the service offered and also benefit from this privilege, I will detail/specify:

We highlight the care and loving kindness that, from the very first minute, characterized our conversations about the boarding, which would be for about 10 days with our 🐱 Simba 🐱, almost 1 year old, and lots of pampering. This was also a factor that contributed to our choice… particularly after we had personally verified the place and the “Aunts and Uncles” (Lúcia and Ângelo). The truth is, the boarding experience was ten times more than all that love and affection. Simba was clearly in a safe and cared-for environment, surrounded by pampering from all sides and at all times.

We recommend (without hesitation!) these people for any service other pets may need. Total trust and joy. 🙏🙏🙏

From zero to 5, where zero means not at all satisfied and 5 means very satisfied:

👉🏼 Cooperation: 5

👉🏼 Transparency: 5
👉🏼 Friendliness: 5

👉🏼 Openness to a first contact pre-visit: 5
👉🏼 Optimization of solutions: 5
👉🏼 Inclusion, whenever possible, of animals in our daily activities: 7!!!🥰🥰🥰

We loved this Easter stay experience and we will repeat it in August and from now on (!!!).

Simba returned home even more affectionate and extremely balanced and happy. It was noticeable!! Gratitude with all our hearts and see you soon. 🥰🥰🥰🙏🙏🙏😘😘😘

From the whole Family: Cristina, Pedro and Vicente. Billy, Maria and Simba, 1 million kisses and see you soon dear Uncles. 🥰😻🫶😘

What can I say about this "family"? That it truly is a family, and that it makes us feel at ease leaving our furry friends with them. The pampering without neglecting professionalism, the constant monitoring of what's happening with the pets was something that delighted us because we don't need to "beg" for news about them, and best of all, the happiness is evident on the pets' faces. The adherence to routines, the care, the attention, the pre-stay meeting to get to know the pets and owners, to learn about routines, fears, etc., all this makes us certain that we made the right decision. Will we repeat the experience? Without a doubt. Will we recommend them? Without a doubt. Now that we know them, we won't hesitate to go on vacation with them because we know that with this family, they'll be VERY WELL cared for and we'll be very well taken care of! Thank you and best wishes 🙌🏻
Super attentive and willing to help!

EntreEajuda Petsitting's services are very careful and detailed, and my family highly recommends them!!
Lúcia and Angelo took care of our 7-month-old dog for a week, and every day we received videos and photos, as well as advice on how to make our routine and life with her more harmonious. She came home much better behaved because they not only took care of her, but also trained her, socialized her with other dogs, and took care of the medication she needed. We completely trust the care they provide for our animals, especially since we know that communication with them is very easy and quick, and because they clearly know a lot about the subject! :)
They were also very flexible when we couldn't arrange a time to pick her up and they found a very good solution quickly! :)
Excellent at handling the dogs. They are very attentive, careful, and provide complete visibility into the dogs' well-being.

Finding EntreAjuda Petsitting brought so much relief and joy to me and my dog!

From the initial visit to the family-run boarding facility, Lúcia and Ângelo were tireless in their support, sharing their knowledge with me (things I put into practice from day one and that left me speechless!), the loving, attentive, and respectful way they receive and treat her, and the continuous updates on her condition.

The entire process, from the first contact to her return to her owner, is very clear, informed, and timely. I can't see any room for improvement; I really appreciate the interaction between everyone, the family atmosphere, the care, and I know my dog ​​does too.

I recommend them with complete confidence!

My dog came home happy after spending 5 days with them. I got videos showing her playing in the park, making friends, everyday. I will use Lucia and Angelo to take care of my baby every time I have to leave the city.

Lucia and Angelo are absolutely incredible, I'd even say "magical," from the pre-visit to meet them (which was absolutely essential for my dog ​​who has separation anxiety), getting to know them, playing, and then everything was hers. They put us at ease and have a beautiful energy that connects with our furry friends. Throughout the stay, they send videos and photos, documenting and sharing everything, including the mischief. They are super available, transparent, attentive, and experienced in handling dogs and their most unpredictable behaviors. They take numerous walks, ensuring everything our furry friend needs for an excellent experience. They provide the necessary security we need when we leave our pet. They are 20 stars and I recommend them 200%.

Quick and detailed communication. Lucia was super attentive from the beginning and very flexible in scheduling the pre-visit, where we met and she was able to meet Tofu – who felt very comfortable and welcomed. I felt confident in her work and safe leaving my furry friend with her. I definitely recommend her!

From the very first moment, from the pre-visit, we were very well received and immediately felt that this would be the ideal place to leave our Oscar for a few days. It was as if we had known each other for a long time.
After leaving our Oscar, they sent many photos and videos and we were able to see how Oscar felt more and more "at home".
Thank you very much for everything and will Oscar come back? Of course he will, if necessary, this is where we will entrust our dog, because we are sure he will be well treated.

We are so grateful for taking such good care of our four-legged daughter, for keeping us informed at all times, and for giving her so much love. 💕
A huge thank you also to all the "grandparents" and "great-grandparents" for their affection!

Kira stayed for 5 days and, at all times, they were super attentive. She even had the opportunity to interact with other large dogs — something that previously scared her — and, on the very first day, she was already playing and socializing calmly. It was simply incredible! 🐾❤️ Without a doubt, I would leave my Kira in their care again. I recommend them 100%! 🌟🐶

I couldn't be more grateful to Google for putting these two angels in my path! I have two dogs, one of whom is already 11 years old. I live in Spain and didn't want to leave him in a kennel, so I searched and found Entreajuda Petsitting (good feedback from other clients and close to where I was going to stay), and I immediately sent them a WhatsApp message. In my case, it was just to take them for a walk at midday. They responded super quickly (considering all the work they do) and, since I'm far away, we had two pre-visits… the first one online where we met via video call and they explained everything I needed to bring, the dynamics of the walks, and asked me for information about my dogs and their routines! The in-person pre-visit was scheduled for the day of our arrival (we even had to change the day, and Lucia and Angelo adapted to us beautifully). During our stay we had to change the time of the walk one day and Angelo was a sweetheart, super helpful and we had no problems at all! I loved the photos and videos of all the walks, from when they arrived home to take them for a walk until they dropped them off again, we knew where they were from the photos! They are super responsible, very attentive to what the owners ask for and in fact I was very calm all week because there is always constant communication about unforeseen events that may arise and a lot of goodwill on the part of Lucia and Angelo in finding solutions quickly! We loved meeting them and I already know that I can go to Lisbon more often to see my family and take my babies because I know they will be in good hands! Thank you so much for everything you did and we will definitely see each other again! Kisses from Xuki and Thor (who already miss you so much - the walks here are not the same 😜) kisses and a big thank you!!!

I 100% recommend Lúcia, Ângelo, Grandma Teresa, and everyone around them.
The truth is, I was very apprehensive about leaving my canine companion at a hotel, as I imagined him inside a kennel all day, sleeping alone.
My dog ​​is very used to being accompanied, and for that, I can only thank Grandma Pet Teresa, who takes care of Panda as if it were us.
In terms of schedule flexibility, they are always available to adjust to us (the owners) and always find the best solution.
I am always at ease because throughout the day I receive news and photos of everything that happens in Panda's life.
When I arrive to pick him up, I feel that he is tired from playing so much and happy.
It was the best solution I found, and I don't regret it at all. From the first day, everyone showed great understanding and respect for Panda, as he is a somewhat shy dog ​​and afraid of other animals.

They encourage him a lot to become more social, but without forcing him.
I truly feel that we've found "a second family" for the panda.
He's happy, and we're happy and at ease.
Thank you so much 🍀❤️
I feel very lucky to have crossed paths with such fantastic people and I hope the panda continues to spend his holidays with GrandparentsPet.

I have no words for the care and affection with which Lúcia and Ângelo and their entire family welcomed my puppy.
From the initial exchange of messages to the pre-visit, it was possible to see the passion they have for animals and the pleasure with which they care for them.
It was the first time I used a service of this kind and I couldn't have chosen better!
My puppy was treated super well, went for many walks and had the opportunity to interact with other dogs and people, which I was able to follow through the many photos and videos they sent throughout the day.
She arrived home happy and tired and I can't recommend the services of this fantastic couple more.
Bennie will be back soon :)
Thank you guys. We really feel that you care and Lily in was in good hands. Appreciate your work and see you later 😉 …

Our experience with EntreEajuda Petsitting was wonderful, if we could give more than five stars, they would receive them all :)
From communication to care, everything was great. Even during the adaptation visit, we felt confident and safe leaving our Ariel with Lúcia and Ângelo. During her stay, we received constant updates on her activities. And we can say that she had immense fun! And so did we <3
Ariel received a lot of affection, visited the countryside, interacted with other dogs, and learned new commands. We were looking for a place where she could feel at home and welcomed, and we are very happy to now know where to leave her in these situations.
There was also flexibility in the schedules. Oh, Ariel got to meet her pet grandparents and great-grandparents and spend a weekend in Alentejo. It was so beautiful to follow her adventures! And now we also feel more confident letting her off-leash so she can continue exploring.

We recommend EntreEajuda Petsitting to anyone who wants their pets to feel at home, even when they're away from home. We loved the experience! We'll definitely be back!

This was the first time I looked for a family-style pet sitting service to leave my Diva with.
And I couldn't have chosen better! Before the stay, a pre-visit was arranged so everyone could get to know each other and we could talk about everything involved in leaving our furry friends in someone's care.
Diva loved the many walks she took… and as her owner, I felt quite at ease since Lúcia and Ângelo shared photos and videos throughout the day.
Diva even learned to rest alone in her bed, something she only did at home when accompanied.
Lúcia and Ângelo, in addition to being friendly, are flexible, super attentive and careful.

From 0 to 10, a 20 out of 10 🫶🏼

I highly recommend them! And I will definitely use their services again!
Pepper spent two days with Lucia and two other dogs and was very well taken care of. She received lots of walks and cuddles.
Thank you for your availability, quick response, and flexibility in scheduling. The videos and photos sent show how well our dog has always been treated.
Amazing ! Highly communicative, trustworthy, and caring. They are the best! Truly family !!!

I highly recommend Lúcia and Ângelo's service! ✨ My dog, Summer, suffers from separation anxiety, and they were simply incredible from the start. I was so grateful for their willingness to schedule a pre-visit so we could meet. During that pre-visit, they listened to all my concerns.

When I left Summer with them for the first time, I felt completely at ease. I received photos and videos of her very frequently, which made me feel very confident and happy to see how well she was being cared for. In addition, they are incredibly kind! You can see their love and dedication to the animals.

Whenever I need someone to look after Summer, I don't think twice. I know that with Lúcia and Ângelo, Summer will be treated with all the love in the world! ❤️

I left my two dogs, Milka and Lindt, with Lúcia and Ângelo, and it was the best choice we could have made! We found them through a friend's recommendation, and the experience exceeded all our expectations. Before booking, we did a pre-visit to see the space where the girls would stay, which was a huge plus and gave us a lot of confidence. During their stay, in addition to taking great care of the girls, they also trained them with dedication and patience. They also kept us informed the whole time, sending photos so we could closely follow how they were doing. Their love for animals is evident. Furthermore, Lúcia and Ângelo are extremely friendly and attentive, which put us completely at ease. Without a doubt, they will always be our first choice to take care of the girls!
I'm immensely grateful for the affection and care they showed my little ones. They loved their stay and the care from Lúcia and Angelo.

I had an absolutely incredible experience with EntreEajuda Petsitting! From our first meeting, where we got to know each other over tea and biscuits, it was clear how dedicated and professional they are.

I left my dog ​​in their care for 10 days and, throughout that period, I received photos, videos, and constant updates. Furthermore, they went above and beyond: they bathed my dog, washed his leash, brushed his fur, and, to my surprise, when I picked him up, I even left with Christmas chocolates!

The flexibility in delivery and pick-up times was another positive point, as were the clear instructions I received throughout the process.

I wholeheartedly recommend EntreEajuda Petsitting's services to anyone looking for someone trustworthy and extremely careful to look after their animals in Lisbon. It's evident that they do the work with a lot of love and attention to detail!
Extremely helpful and attentive. Impeccable service. My kittens were in very good hands. If needed, I will definitely use EntreEajuda Petsitting again. I recommend them.

I only have one thing to say: Excellence! 💫
Lucia and Ângelo are the people who take the best care of our friends. 🐶🐺🦜
Whether it's for walking them, looking after them during the holidays, or having them visit your home.

I have complete trust in them. For my dog, they are family. He's just as happy as if they were his owners.

I recommend them without hesitation; they are the best.

Thank you, Lucia and Ângelo, for your invaluable help throughout this year 🩶🙏🫂

I highly recommend the pet sitting service.

Our Rocky loves it, he's very spoiled and well cared for.
Lots of walks and playtime.

What more could he want?

I have a chinchilla, who always comes back stressed when I leave her in the care of other people, but that wasn't the case this time. She came back very relaxed and calm, and I'm very grateful that they took such good care of her. …

Our Zuvi is always treated super well, whether by Lúcia and Ângelo, or by her parents (pet grandparents). They are even careful with medication if necessary.
We even get scared that she won't want to come back 😂❤️ …

Simply spectacular, we often write comments to be nice, but based on my experience this week (8) I can't just be nice.

Excellent service with constant updates via video and photo. Sam had company, affection, and was very well cared for by Lúcia and Ângelo. The space is good, perfectly suited for a cat, with good dimensions and several scratching posts. The …

Lúcia, Ângelo, and the EntreEajuda family have become family to Cuca as well. Their understanding and knowledge of animals makes them the ideal choice of pet sitters, and they went above and beyond to ensure our pet's comfort. …

It was the perfect and right choice to leave our little 4-legged girl with 😃
Zoe was only 5 months old and they took great care and attention to her needs.
Since we were a little worried about leaving our girl, Grandma Pet Ana Paula, …

Lúcia and Ângelo looked after our cat Camões while we were away for a few days, and the experience couldn't have been better. They kept us informed at all times when they would be returning, sent photos and videos of the cat whenever …
